mainEntity.name: How do I find a registered accountant in Canberra–Queanbeyan through your service?

acceptedAnswer.text: Enter your Canberra or Queanbeyan postcode and what you need help with in our 60-second questionnaire. We match you with a vetted local accountant whose services fit your situation — not just any firm on a map. You can verify any agent on the public TPB register at tpb.gov.au.

mainEntity.name: Are all the Canberra–Queanbeyan accountants in your network registered tax agents?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Every accounting firm in our Canberra–Queanbeyan network is thoroughly vetted. They are fully qualified Registered Tax Agents, CPAs, or Chartered Accountants — all registered with the Tax Practitioners Board (TPB) and operating in compliance with ACT/NSW and Australian Tax Office (ATO) standards.

mainEntity.name: Can a Canberra–Queanbeyan accountant help with both my personal tax return and my small business?

acceptedAnswer.text: Absolutely. Many Canberra firms handle both individual returns and business accounting. Whether you need a personal tax return in Braddon, company tax structuring in Canberra City, or SMSF advice in Queanbeyan, we match you with a specialist suited to your exact requirements across Canberra and Queanbeyan.

mainEntity.name: What if I need an accountant who understands Canberra's property market and ACT/NSW tax rules?

acceptedAnswer.text: The Canberra–Queanbeyan area spans two jurisdictions. In the ACT, land tax applies to residential properties that are not your principal place of residence — with no tax-free threshold, so it is charged from the first dollar of the average unimproved value. Queanbeyan properties fall under NSW rules, including NSW land tax and stamp duty. ACT payroll tax applied above a $2 million annual wages threshold in 2025–26; from 1 July 2026 the ACT Government lowered the threshold to $1.75 million (with a base rate of 6.75%). We match you with an accountant who understands both the ACT and NSW systems and how they apply to investment property, negative gearing changes and capital gains.

mainEntity.name: How quickly will a Canberra–Queanbeyan accountant contact me after I complete the questionnaire?

acceptedAnswer.text: Most matches are completed within 60 seconds of finishing the questionnaire. Your matched firm will typically reach out within 2 hours, or you can call for immediate assistance to discuss your needs and schedule a consultation at their Canberra or Queanbeyan office or by phone.

mainEntity.name: Is the Canberra–Queanbeyan matching service really free with no obligation?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Our matching service is 100% free with zero obligation. You can speak with your matched accountant, review their initial offer, and decide if you want to proceed — no pressure, no hidden fees. We are engaged by the accounting firms, not by you.

mainEntity.name: Can I get a Canberra–Queanbeyan accountant who offers phone or video consultations instead of an office visit?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Many firms in our Canberra–Queanbeyan network offer fully digital cloud services via Xero, MYOB, and phone or Zoom consultations. You can specify whether you prefer in-person meetings in Canberra City or online service during your questionnaire — whichever suits your schedule.

acceptedAnswer.text: We cover all of Canberra and Queanbeyan — from Canberra City and Braddon to Belconnen, Tuggeranong, Gungahlin and Queanbeyan. Enter your postcode in the questionnaire and we will match you with a vetted accountant whose services fit your area, whether you are in the city centre or the outer suburbs.
